hooks.name: Verify before done
hooks.description: On completion, reminds the agent to run the conformance + test gate and act on the FIX lines before treating a code task as done. A safety net for models that declare done without verifying.

action.prompt: Before treating this as done: if you changed any Kotlin, Gradle, resource, or design-canon file this turn, run `./gradlew assembleDebug check` from `projects/Sudoku/` and confirm it prints "rules, 0 violations" with no failed tests. Every conformance failure prints a `FIX:` line stating the exact edit — apply it and re-run rather than guessing. For a quick inner loop use `./gradlew conformanceCheck -Pconformance.fast=true`. Do not report a code task complete while any rule fails or any test is red. If you only answered a question or changed nothing that compiles, disregard this.
